VIJERON / CUTTING ROOM

Method, formulas and references

Calculation assumptions, examples and usage limits.

Panel arithmetic

The cut width fits across usable fabric width without rotation. Pieces per row are rounded down, rows rounded up, then multiplied by cut length. Extra length is optional and user-selected. The tool rejects a panel wider than usable fabric.

Edging arithmetic

All four sides of a rectangle total 2 × (width + length). A user-supplied joining allowance is added, then required rolls are rounded up. This does not calculate corner technique or tape width.

Editorial process

Text, numerical examples and diagrams were made for Vijeron on 9 October 2026. References check seam, measurement, grain and shrinkage concepts. We claim no fabric tests, garment patterns or sewing certification. Material changes are recorded in Git.
